AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: RethinkDNS provides DNS firewall and VPN protection for Android devices. Operational Patterns: - Call getVpnStatus before startVpn, stopVpn, pauseVpn, or resumeVpn to check current state. - Confirm with the user before calling stopVpn because it removes network protection. Constraints: - VPN permission must be granted before startVpn can succeed.
